text:
maria: FYI vendor Ines just confirmed a partial RMA split on AWB CX12345 and CX12346. They're proposing split-shipment to avoid customs hold, but want us to pick up 40% of expedited surcharge.
vendor-ines: Sorry for the curveball — original batch had a customs doc issue. We can send 6 units on CX12345 (ETA 48h) and 9 units on CX12346 (ETA 72h). Remaining 5 will be refurbished and shipped next week. Insurance will cover base claim, but forwarding surcharge is chargeable.
sam: Can you confirm the surcharge number? We need to compare against honoring vendor credit line. Numbers matter for budget.
vendor-ines: Surcharge = $1,200 (air uplift) + $150 brokerage. We can absorb $500 of uplift if Redwood covers brokerage.
maria: That uplift number seems high. Liam, do we have any runway on loaners to cover immediate capacity? If yes, we might avoid airway.
liam: We have 4 H100 loaners left in FRA pool but they're tagged for infra-testing next week. If we divert them that's a schedule risk. How critical is the 48h batch?
maria: Cluster health: two production islands are starved tonight if we don't get at least 6 units in EU region. Latency SLOs slipping at  p999. We'll need that 48h batch.
sam: Ok we likely need the early air. Ops: propose cost split: Redwood pays uplift ($700) + vendor covers $500 + brokerage $150? That leaves $700 for us. Agree?
vendor-ines: We can accept vendor absorbs $500, Redwood covers $700 uplift + $150 brokerage = $850. We'll issue adjusted invoice with credit line applied.
liam: Quick ask — can vendor confirm AWB numbers and share POD / photos for customs to prevent another hold? We should also get serial range for RMA items to reconcile after intake.
vendor-ines: AWBs: CX12345, CX12346. I'll DM the full manifest and photos to maria. Serial ranges attached will be in the manifest.
maria: Please also confirm whether the 5 refurbished units have fresh firmware or are stock. We had a prior mismatch (hotfix required) that caused a depot rework.
vendor-ines: Refurbs are N-1 firmware. We will flash to N on staging before ship next week.
sam: Logistics note — put this on expedited inbound pipeline and tag as "rma-expedite-eu" so our receiving team prioritizes customs clearance. ops-bot: Received tag request: rma-expedite-eu applied to inbound manifest CX12345,CX12346.
liam: I'll reserve 6 slots on the FRA receiving dock for tomorrow morning window 06:00-10:00. Maria, please confirm carrier ETA updates in the thread.
maria: Got it. Vendor, please confirm manifest DM and updated invoice by EOD. If we see any additional brokerage or duty, escalate to procurement immediately. :white_check_mark:
vendor-ines: Will do — sending manifest + updated invoice within 2 hours. Thanks. :thumbsup:
